sub_graphs.title: Fulu: Deterministic Proposer Lookahead (EIP-7917)
sub_graphs.description: Models the proposer lookahead computation, storage, and epoch-based rotation that replaces on-demand proposer index derivation

nodes.description: Shifts the proposer lookahead window by removing the earliest epoch's indices and appending newly computed proposers for current_epoch + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1

nodes.description: Generates proposer index sequence for an epoch by computing per-slot seeds via hashing (seed || slot_offset) then deriving proposer from candidate pool of active validators

nodes.description: The proposer_lookahead field in BeaconState now contains proposer indices for the current and next epoch, with length (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

nodes.description: The proposer for the current slot is deterministically known from the pre-computed lookahead vector

nodes.description: Retrieve the seed for the DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER for the target epoch from beacon state randao mixes

sub_graphs.title: Fulu: Dynamic Blob Parameter Schedule (EIP-7892)
sub_graphs.description: Models the blob-only hardfork mechanism that allows dynamic adjustment of max blobs per block via a configuration schedule

nodes.label: Blob Schedule Configuration Loaded
nodes.description: The BLOB_SCHEDULE configuration containing epoch-indexed BlobParameters entries is available to the node

nodes.label: Resolve Blob Parameters for Epoch
nodes.description: Iterate BLOB_SCHEDULE in descending epoch order to find the applicable BlobParameters entry for the given epoch. Falls back to ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH defaults if no match

nodes.label: Blob Parameters Resolved
nodes.description: The max_blobs_per_block value for the current epoch is determined from the schedule

nodes.label: Validate Blob Commitment Count
nodes.description: Check that len(body.blob_kzg_commitments) <= resolved max_blobs_per_block

nodes.label: Blob Count Within Limit
nodes.description: The number of blob commitments in the block is within the dynamically resolved limit

nodes.label: Blob Count Exceeds Limit
nodes.description: The block contains more blob commitments than the epoch limit allows, triggering rejection

nodes.label: Compute Fork Digest with Blob Params
nodes.description: XOR base fork digest with hash of (epoch || max_blobs_per_block) to incorporate blob schedule into fork separation

nodes.label: Fork Digest Reflects Blob Schedule
nodes.description: The fork digest now encodes the current blob parameters, ensuring peers on different blob schedules are separated

ambiguities.text: The fallback behavior of get_blob_parameters when no BLOB_SCHEDULE entry matches: 'Falls back to ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH defaults' is referenced but the exact default values for ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH blob parameters are not specified in this document.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the fallback returns the blob parameters that were in effect at ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH (i.e., the Electra-era defaults, likely 6 max blobs per block). This needs cross-reference with Electra spec.

ambiguities.text: The constraint 'entries should be sorted ascending' in BLOB_SCHEDULE uses 'should' rather than 'must', leaving it ambiguous whether this is a strict requirement or a recommendation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a strict requirement (MUST). The descending iteration in get_blob_parameters depends on sorted order for correctness. Unsorted entries would produce incorrect parameter resolution.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify the behavior of the proposer_lookahead vector at genesis or at the Fulu fork activation epoch. How is the vector initially populated?
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the vector is fully populated during fork upgrade processing or genesis initialization by computing proposer indices for all epochs in the lookahead window. This needs verification against fork transition code.

ambiguities.text: The XOR operation in compute_fork_digest combines the base fork digest with a hash of blob parameters, but it's unclear whether the hash is truncated to 4 bytes (ForkDigest size) before XOR or if the XOR operates on a larger value.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the blob parameters hash is truncated to ForkDigest size (4 bytes) before XOR, consistent with existing fork digest conventions.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLOB_SCHEDULE configuration is assumed to be correct and agreed upon by all nodes. There is no on-chain mechanism to validate or enforce the schedule; it is a client configuration value.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If nodes disagree on BLOB_SCHEDULE, they will compute different fork digests and partition into separate networks. Blocks valid under one schedule would be invalid under another, causing chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The proposer lookahead assumes that the RANDAO mixes used for seed computation are available and finalized by the time process_proposer_lookahead runs at epoch boundaries.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If RANDAO mixes are unavailable or manipulated, proposer assignments could be predictable or biased, enabling targeted attacks on specific proposer slots.

implicit_assumptions.description: The deterministic proposer lookahead reveals future proposers MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1 epochs in advance. The assumption is that this advance knowledge does not significantly advantage attackers beyond what was already possible.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers with advance knowledge of proposer assignments could prepare targeted DoS attacks, front-running strategies, or MEV extraction schemes against known future proposers.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations are assumed to update their BLOB_SCHEDULE configuration in sync with the scheduled epoch changes. There is no protocol-level enforcement of this.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients that miss a blob schedule update would reject valid blocks (or accept invalid ones) after the scheduled epoch, effectively forking themselves off the network.

implicit_assumptions.description: The XOR-based fork digest modification assumes that blob parameter changes produce sufficiently distinct digests to prevent accidental peer connections between nodes on different schedules.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If hash collisions occur in the truncated XOR result, nodes on different blob schedules could connect and exchange incompatible blocks, causing validation failures and potential consensus issues.
